Parsec · Volvo truck catalog

Truck catalogEvery Volvo model, generation and configuration that comes through the shop, and the picture each one needs.

  • The picturesCut out from the screenshots you sent, background removed so they sit on the page in both themes. They're small in the screenshots, so they look soft when shown big. The original files from ChatGPT would be sharper.
  • Still drawnNine have no picture yet: VN 420 and VN 770, VNL 440 Electric, the first VNX 300 and 430, the first VHD 300, and the three all-new VNX models. They show a plain drawing of the configuration until a picture is added.
  • Your photosYour own photos stay on VNL 760, VNL 860 and VNR 300 (Other picture shows the new one). Your red photo is the picture for any VHD that has no closer match.
  • In ParsecParsec 9.9 carries every picture here: the RO header, RO list, Search, Foreman and Triage, the bays and notes on the truck. Each one is in Your data › Truck pictures, where you can replace or remove it.
  • MatchingParsec matches the RO's model (VNL 760) and gets the year from the VIN. The full model code (VNL64T760) also tells the axles and the front axle. Try one at the top.
  • Trims and axlesTrims on the new VNL (Core, Edge, Edge Black, Ultimate) change the finish, not the shape. Axle, front-axle and truck/tractor choices show on the drawing. One picture per model is enough.
  • What's in itVolvo Trucks North America from 1996 to today: VNL, VNR, VNX, VHD, VAH, VNM and VT. Sources are Volvo and the trade press, October 2026. A ? means it isn't confirmed.
